propositions: PydanticAIRunner.run() spans 408 lines (59% of runner.py) and must be decomposed into plain functions ordered by code density and growth patterns.
ProviderSession is constructed at line 301 but the try guard starts at line 474, leaving lines 301-473 outside the guard and leaking an httpx.AsyncClient when raises occur in the pre-call window.

Three child extractions (interpret_failure, build_model_settings/build_usage_limits, and provider session context manager guard) must each individually leave runner.py under 700 LOC when stacked, because Verified is cast per patchset and a red ancestor blocks submission.

The provider session guard must be implemented as `with ProviderSession(cfg) as provider_session:` using __enter__/__exit__ already defined but never used, and the _NoBuildProviderSession stub must gain these methods in the same commit.

build_model_settings extraction must preserve the _TEMPERATURE_WITHDRAWN_LOGGED side effect inline in run() rather than moving it, to maintain the structured_run leaf invariant and avoid circular import dependencies.

Six monkeypatch.setattr targets that move between modules must have their rebind hazards repointed in the same commit as the extraction, because re-exporting a name fixes only `from` imports, not setattr patches.
